messages:
mina-docs: Hey team — opened a small PR to clarify the pricing + metering section around tiered quotas. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 :eyes:
ben-eng: Thanks Mina — skimmed. the examples are good but the SDK snippet for checking remaining quota is out of date w/ the new /usage API.
sara-product: can you paste the current snippet here? i want to ensure product examples show per-customer vs org-level quotas clearly.
mina-docs: current snippet in the PR (line ~120):
```js
// old example (deprecated)
const remaining = await client.getQuota('team-id');
console.log(remaining);
```
mina-docs: ben, suggestion was to replace with the new usage endpoint and show how to compute monthly remaining units given tier allowances.
ben-eng: propose this short Node example:
```js
// recommended: compute remaining tokens for the month
const usage = await client.usage.list({ orgId: 'org_123', start: '2026-02-01', end: '2026-02-28' });
const usedTokens = usage.items.reduce((s, r) => s + r.token_count, 0);
const tierAllowance = 10_000_000; // tokens per month for Starter tier
console.log(`remaining: ${tierAllowance - usedTokens}`);
```
omar-analytics: small note: usage.items might be paginated; add a short hint about pageToken or using aggregated endpoint. also the dashboard screenshots reference "Tier A / B" which is old naming — should be "Starter / Pro" in the docs.
mina-docs: good catch Omar — i'll change labels and add a short sentence re pagination. suggestion for one-liner about rate-limit headers? people ask how to detect burst throttling via API.
ben-eng: add example checking headers on responses: `x-rw-rate-limit-remaining` and `x-rw-rate-limit-reset` — quick curl snippet should suffice.
mina-docs: adding both code + curl. will include both on the same page near the metering section.
sara-product: also confirm pricing table link — it pointed to /pricing#legacy which 404s in site nav. needs to go to /pricing#metered-usage.
mina-docs: ok i'll update the anchor and add a redirect note for SEO.
release-bot: deploy-preview created for branch docs/pricing-metering-clarify — netlify/preview/PR-4321
ben-eng: quick wording nit: "units" -> "tokens" in two places (users get confused otherwise).
mina-docs: noted. i'll swap "units" -> "tokens" and add a short FAQ Q: How are tokens counted? with a one-liner + link to tokenizer tool.
omar-analytics: can we also add a screenshot of the new analytics dashboard showing per-route cost breakdown? i'll attach a small image to the PR after lunch. that will help ops teams.
mina-docs: perfect — i'll reserve a figure slot and caption it.
sara-product: timeline? we want this in the docs-weekly release on Friday.
mina-docs: i can push updates today, but need one more review from Ben for snippets + Omar for wording on pagination/labels.
ben-eng: i'll do a pass in the morning and leave inline comments. :+1:
omar-analytics: same — will check screenshots/text today.
mina-docs: thanks all — checklist i'm going to commit: 1) replace SDK snippet with usage aggregation example, 2) add curl header example, 3) fix pricing anchor, 4) change "Tier A/B" to "Starter/Pro", 5) FAQ token counting, 6) note about pagination. will ping when done.
ben-eng: sounds good.
mina-docs: done — pushed an update and fixed the anchor. PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321/files
release-bot: PR 4321 updated (1 file changed, 12 insertions, 8 deletions)
omar-analytics: reviewed + approved screenshots and wording. added one tiny comment re alt text for the image.
ben-eng: reviewed code snippets, small style nit fixed, approved.
sara-product: approved from product. looks ready for Friday docs release. :tada:
mina-docs: merging after CI passes. thanks everyone!
